    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε)  := by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero =>
    intro h
    exact (Nat.not_lt_zero _ h).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      intro _ u h
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
        prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq, Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at h
      have hu : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      rw [hu]
      exact hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) h
    | succ n =>
      intro _ u h
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at h
      rw [prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
        (P := multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close (MC := MC) u e)] at h
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA u e
      apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e h)
      apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (ih (Nat.succ_pos _)) u ⟨r, hr⟩

    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε)  := by
  intro ϑ hϑ
  induction ϑ, hϑ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    intro u h
    rw [show u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) from
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1)
    conv_lhs => rw [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
    simpa only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u),
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using h
  | succ n hn ih =>
    intro u h
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (C := MC) u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e ?_) ?_
    · conv_lhs => rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form u] at h
      exact h
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (MC := MC) ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1)

theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε)  := by
  intro ϑ hϑ
  induction ϑ, hϑ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    intro u h
    rw [show u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) from
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1)
    simpa only [← @prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq F _ ⟨0⟩,
      multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using h
  | succ n hn ih =>
    intro u h
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA MC u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_) ?_
    · simp only [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
      simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at h
      exact h
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩
